title: Adapter run status
description: The status.json an adapter writes into its own output directory for `<adapter> run`, reporting its self-assessed outcome independently of its process exit status. Adapters attempt to write it even on a failure path; benchctl reads it in results.rs and folds it into the sealed kafkars.run-status.v1 document. Documentation mirror of the AdapterStatus serde type in crates/bench-schema/src/adapter.rs, which is the source of truth.

outcome.description: The adapter's own verdict. An adapter that succeeded can still belong to an invalid run; validity is the separate classification axis.

stage.description: Which adapter stage failed, for example setup, warmup, measured, or drain.
